evals.name: locate-python
evals.prompt: 能帮我找一下电脑上装了几个 python.exe 吗？分别在什么位置？
evals.expected_output: Uses es.exe to find python.exe locations, reports count and full paths of each installation
expectations: Reports the count of python.exe instances found
Shows full paths of found python.exe locations

evals.name: search-pdfs
evals.prompt: 帮我搜一下电脑里所有文件名带 'report' 的 PDF 文件，显示前 20 个
evals.expected_output: Uses es.exe to search for PDF files with 'report' in name, limits to 20 results
expectations: Combines file extension (.pdf) with name pattern (report) in the search
Shows full paths of found files

evals.name: locate-dependency
evals.prompt: 我跑 Python 脚本报错说找不到 numpy，但我明明装过。能帮我找一下 numpy 装在哪了吗？
evals.expected_output: Uses es.exe to locate numpy package directories or files on the system, reports found locations
expectations: Uses es.exe to locate numpy-related files or directories
Searches for numpy in common Python package locations (site-packages, conda envs, etc.)
Reports found numpy installation paths to the user
Provides helpful suggestions if numpy is not found in the expected locations

evals.name: wrong-context
evals.prompt: 帮我搜一下当前项目里所有包含 'TODO' 的代码文件
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this is about content search in the current project and uses Grep instead of es.exe
expectations: Does NOT use es.exe for this task
Uses Grep or similar content-search tool instead
Searches within the current project directory specifically
